tasks.title: Focal length in pixels from the field of view
tasks.solution: f_x = (W/2) / tan(HFOV/2): half the frame width over half the angle.

tasks.title: Depth from stereo
tasks.solution: Z = f·B/d (B in meters). A 1 px disparity error at small d gives a large depth error: stereo accuracy degrades with the square of the distance.

tasks.title: How much ground one pixel covers
tasks.solution: Pixel size on the object = Z/f. At f = 800 and 100 m it's 12.5 cm: a detection error of a couple of pixels is a quarter of a meter.
